ننكرب (form VII)
# نَنْكَرِبُ (nankaribu) /nan.ka.ri.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْكَرَبَ (inkaraba)
# نَنْكَرِبَ (nankariba) /nan.ka.ri.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْكَرَبَ (inkaraba)
# نَنْكَرِبْ (nankarib) /nan.ka.rib/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْكَرَبَ (inkaraba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
